title: Twin Eagles — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Twin Eagles.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Outdoor Premium." Premium tier. Twin Eagles makes premium outdoor grills and kitchen components with their direct-flame infrared searing system. Strong in the independent dealer outdoor kitchen segment.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Premium outdoor kitchen builds through independent dealers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Twin Eagles:

• Direct-flame infrared searing

• Premium stainless construction

• Independent dealer focused

• Strong outdoor kitchen ecosystem

• Competitive with Lynx and Fire Magic
